target.title: feat: add bridge rich links
target.body:
## Summary
- add `send-rich --url <url> --rich-link` for bridge-backed URL preview balloon sends
- forward RPC `send.rich` params `url` + `rich_link: true` into the bridge
- build URL preview payloads as `RichLink`-rooted archives containing fetched `LPLinkMetadata`, hidden preview-image transfer metadata, and rich-link body/data-detector attributes matching Messages.app compose behavior
- link the injected helper against LinkPresentation in all helper build/sign paths
- fix queued CLI/RPC identity resolution so URL-only rich-link sends resolve using the effective URL text
- keep release-owned changelog changes out of the branch

## Redacted runtime proof on lobster
Proof collected on lobster with branch-local artifacts from `feat/rich-links` and a freshly relaunched SIP-disabled injected Messages.app session. Raw logs stay local because they include chat GUIDs, message GUIDs, row IDs, and local identifiers.

- branch head: `885e5a4`
- working proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/165-rich-links/working-20260708-234615`
- earlier exploratory proof directories remain under `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/165-rich-links/`
- test chat: `Lobster Test Group` (chat row 22; GUID redacted in PR text)
- before-fix bridge rows: URL preview rows had no usable hidden preview transfer and rendered as load-preview placeholders / did not appear correctly recipient-side
- manual Messages.app compose comparison row: native URL preview row persisted `balloon_bundle_id=com.apple.messages.URLBalloonProvider`, `message_summary_info={enc:true,eogcd:3,ust:true}`, hidden outgoing `.pluginPayloadAttachment`, `cache_has_attachments=1`, and `has_dd_results=1`
- branch working row: row 6774 for `https://lobster.shahine.com/` persisted `balloon_bundle_id=com.apple.messages.URLBalloonProvider`, `payload_data` length 2155, `message_summary_info` length 72, `cache_has_attachments=1`, `has_dd_results=1`, and attributed body length 1150
- branch hidden preview transfer: attachment row 310 had `.pluginPayloadAttachment`, `total_bytes=107835`, `is_outgoing=1`, `hide_attachment=1`, `transfer_state=5`, `preview_generation_state=3`
- branch payload archive contained `RichLink`, `LPLinkMetadata`, `RichLinkImageAttachmentSubstitute`, `contentImages`, `contentImagesMetadata`, `icons`, `images`, `LPImageMetadata`, and `LPIconMetadata`
- visual confirmation from user: the recipient-side Messages UI showed the generated rich card rendering with title/domain/image after tapping through the preview placeholder

Working row comparison excerpt:
```
manual row 6752: URLBalloonProvider payload_len=1980 summary_len=72 cache_has_attachments=1 has_dd_results=1 attr_len=1011
branch row 6774: URLBalloonProvider payload_len=2155 summary_len=72 cache_has_attachments=1 has_dd_results=1 attr_len=1150
```

Hidden preview attachment comparison excerpt:
```
manual row 6752: .pluginPayloadAttachment total_bytes=107835 is_outgoing=1 hide_attachment=1 transfer_state=5 preview_generation_state=3
branch row 6774: .pluginPayloadAttachment total_bytes=107835 is_outgoing=1 hide_attachment=1 transfer_state=5 preview_generation_state=3
```

## Verification
- `make build` ✅ on lobster for `885e5a4`
- `swift format lint --recursive Sources Tests TestsLinux` ✅
- `git diff --check` ✅
- `make lint` ⚠️ blocked after swift-format by local SwiftLint/SourceKit crash: `Loading sourcekitdInProc.framework/Versions/A/sourcekitdInProc failed`
- `make test` ⚠️ blocked before project tests run on this host: `Tests/IMsgCoreTests/BridgeHelperLocatorTests.swift:2:8: error: no such module 'Testing'`
- CI repair note: previous macOS CI failed because `BridgeCommandRegistrationTests.bridgeAttachmentStagingUsesChatGuid` still asserted the old `prepareOutgoingTransfer(..., chatGuid, &prepErr)` helper signature; `885e5a4` updates that source-level assertion to the current rich-link helper signature and normal-attachment call shape
